name: Leverage-led-not-price divergence — rich basis x stalling price (perp short)
rationale: CROSS-METRIC DIVERGENCE (perp_spot_basis x price), SHORT — an OI/leverage-divergence-style read built on the stationary basis instead of the non-stationary OI level. The signal is a divergence: the perp_spot_basis is RICH (perp trades at a premium = leverage is bid, longs paying up for exposure) WHILE the underlying PRICE has STALLED (a short-window ret near zero or rolling over). That divergence — leverage-bid but price-not-following — means the rally is being driven by derivatives positioning rather than genuine spot demand, a hollow structure that tends to unwind DOWN when the leverage gets squeezed. This is the basis analogue of the classic OI-up-price-flat weak-rally fade, made honest by using the bounded basis fraction (not a raw OI notional level that can't be thresholded). Mechanism before data: short when perp_spot_basis is above a fitted premium ceiling AND ret over a short window is between +/- a small band (stalled, via the symmetric between op) ; stop ABOVE, take-profit BELOW; exit when basis normalizes down (leverage relieved). Distinct from perp-basis-premium-contrarian-short (basis rich + price RISING momentum — a different price condition), funding-contrarian-crash-filter (funding, not basis), and g2-funding-basis-double-crowding (requires BOTH gauges rich + rollover). The novelty is the basis-RICH x price-STALLED DIVERGENCE. Disconfirmer 1: drop the price-stall arm — if shorting any rich basis matches the deflated Sharpe, the divergence adds nothing. Disconfirmer 2: a rich basis with rising price is a healthy trend (a LONG), so the stall arm must be load-bearing; if removing it flips the edge sign, the read is just 'short rich basis'. Disconfirmer 3 (PIT/cost): perp short pays/earns funding; net of ~20bps+. tier0 perp_spot_basis + tier0 ret_Nd, fresh prod data, unproven combination — low-confidence until OOS; SHORT = perp.
catalyst: perp_spot_basis rich (leverage bid) WHILE price has stalled (ret within a flat band) — a hollow leverage-led rally faded with a perp short
